# Bosch Limited

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-30 · status **partial** · Budget spent: primary MCA/BRSR/annual-report PDFs (NSE, BSE, scribd) were either unreadable (timeout) or HELD by robots/registry rules; relied on official bosch.in pages and a third-party MCA-data aggregator (thebhoomi.in) for spend detail. Statutory annexure fields (average net profit, prescribed CSR %, admin overheads, impact assessment cost/done, excess/unspent) could not be confirmed from a primary filing within budget.

Confirmed Bosch Limited (CIN L85110KA1951PLC000761) as the Section 135-bound Indian listed entity, and Bosch India Foundation as its (and other Bosch India entities') CSR implementation partner/foundation, kept as a separate record with parent_name Bosch Limited. Found FY2024-25 aggregate CSR spend of Rs 29.92 Cr across 38 disclosed MCA projects (8 states, 10 districts), plus 15 largest FY2024-25 and 15 largest FY2023-24 project-level rows (sector, state, district, directly-implemented vs agency-implemented) from a third-party MCA-data aggregator (thebhoomi.in). Identified flagship recurring programme BRIDGE (largest project both years), the umbrella 'Bosch India Social Engagement' theme, and the employee-driven Primavera child-welfare initiative. Could not access a primary MCA/BRSR/annual-report filing (NSE PDF timed out twice, BSE/scribd/LinkedIn were HELD), so statutory annexure figures (net profit, prescribed CSR %, overheads, impact assessment), FY2022-23 data, PAN/CSR-1 numbers, named NGO partners, a CSR-specific contact mailbox and any open RFP were not found within budget.

Website: https://www.bosch.in

## What it set out to find

- identity/identifiers for Bosch Limited and Bosch India Foundation (CIN, PAN, CSR-1, parent/foundation relationship)
- funder_csr_years for FY2024-25, FY2023-24, FY2022-23 (obligation, spend, overheads, impact assessment)
- funder_csr_spend detail: sector, state, district, implementing agency, amount, by year
- footprints and stated priority geography, kept separate
- named NGO/implementing-agency partners by year
- programs/themes
- metrics
- published CSR contact mailbox
- documents (annual report, CSR annexure, BRSR)
- open RFPs / partner-with-us calls
